answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is by requiring each identity to maintain a personal stake of non-transferable yarrow tokens that decay unless the agent periodically proves unique context through a prism of private challenge responses. A vine of shared credentials collapses under this because the stake cannot be pooled; each fake identity must grow its own decaying yarrow or forfeit future mining rights, making large farms economically unviable as the prism of independent proofs multiplies the cost superlinearly.
